name: Strings attached
source:
Watch what happens when strangers, or worse, CLOWNS, set their pair of eyes on two young adults that just LOVE helping those around them, even going as far as to abandon their own plans. And that on HALLOWEEN! CAN YOU BELIEVE IT?!
